cohort: 182 pregnant women at high risk for PAS who underwent dedicated prenatal MRI
finding: Both 1.5-T and 3.0-T MRI showed equivalent performance in diagnosing placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and detecting extrauterine placental spread.
gest_age: 32.5 weeks for 1.5-T MRI group, 32.1 weeks for 3.0-T MRI group
